display.purpose: All-caps scene statements; per-scene size set from the measured em width of the longest word, noted in a CSS comment.

headline.purpose: All-caps section statements, including the Story quote.

title.purpose: Sentence-case sub-heads such as spec names.

lead.purpose: The one sentence of a scene, max 34ch, ink-2.

label.purpose: UI words that are not measurements: nav, CTA text, spec terms, captions, hints.

measure.purpose: Geist Mono, only for measured values, positions and years.

shadows.name: swatch-ring
shadows.purpose: Outlines a material swatch circle. The only shadow in the system; nothing is lifted.

depthPlanes.name: back-plane (scene)

depthPlanes.purpose: Display type beneath the transparent WebGL canvas inside scroll scenes.

depthPlanes.name: front-plane

motion.name: ease-out

components.name: CTA
components.description: The one call-to-action form: expanded-caps label and a hairline that extends toward the action.
components.html: Discover X1
components.css: .ds-cta { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; min-height: 48px; padding-block: 0.75rem; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 120; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ece8e1; background: none; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-cta:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-cta-rule { --reach: 32px; position: relative; display: block; width: 88px; height: 12px; margin-right: calc(var(--reach) * -1); } .ds-cta-rule::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 1px; top: 50%; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0.636); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-cta-head { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; width: 12px; height: 12px; transform: translateX(calc(var(--reach) * -1)); transition: transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-cta:hover .ds-cta-rule::before, .ds-cta:focus-visible .ds-cta-rule::before { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-cta:hover .ds-cta-head, .ds-cta:focus-visible .ds-cta-head { transform: none; } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.css: .ds-mat-group { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-mat { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, #ece8e1 16%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: #b2aea7; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 240ms ease, color 240ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-mat:hover { color: #ece8e1; border-color: color-mix(in oklab, #ece8e1 34%, transparent); } .ds-mat:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-mat:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-mat[aria-checked='true'] { color: #ece8e1; border-color: #ece8e1; } .ds-mat-swatch { position: relative; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--swatch); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, #ece8e1 30%, transparent); } .ds-mat-swatch::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -5px; width: 1.5px; height: 4px; margin-left: -0.75px; background: #ff5a1f; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(3px); transition: opacity 200ms ease, transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-mat[aria-checked='true'] .ds-mat-swatch::after { opacity: 1; transform: none; } .ds-mat-name { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 118; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.css: .ds-callout { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: flex-start; color: #ece8e1; padding-top: 4px; } .ds-callout-marker { position: relative; width: 11px; height: 11px; margin-top: 28px; border: 1px solid #ff5a1f; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-callout-marker::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 3.5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff5a1f; } .ds-callout-leader { margin-left: -5px; } .ds-callout-chip { display: grid; gap: 2px; margin-top: -10px; padding: 5px 8px 6px; background: color-mix(in oklab, #0c0c0d 82%, transparent); border-left: 1px solid #ff5a1f; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-callout-name { color: #8f8c87; } .ds-callout-value { color: #ece8e1; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 1.5rem; color: #ece8e1; } .ds-rail-readout { display: grid; justify-items: end; gap: 2px; padding: 4px 8px; background: color-mix(in oklab, #0c0c0d 72%, transparent); text-align: right; } .ds-rail-measure { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 450; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; color: #d3cfc8; } .ds-rail-num { color: #ece8e1; } .ds-rail-of { color: #8f8c87; } .ds-rail-ticks { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-rail-tick { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; width: 28px; height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-tick::before { content: ''; display: block; width: 26px; height: 1px; background: #8f8c87; transform: scaleX(0.385); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease; } .ds-rail-tick:hover::before { transform: scaleX(0.7); background: #ece8e1; } .ds-rail-tick[aria-current='step']::before { transform: none; background: #ece8e1; } .ds-rail-tick:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; height: 4.25rem; padding-inline: 2rem; color: #ece8e1; background: #0c0c0d; } .ds-nav-logo { justify-self: start; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 125; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-nav-list { display: flex; gap: 2rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-nav-link, .ds-nav-explore { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 118; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding-block: 0.75rem; color: #b2aea7; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0.45rem; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: #ece8e1; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-explore:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ff5a1f; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-nav-explore { justify-self: end; display: inline-flex; gap: 0.55em; padding: 0.75rem 0; font-weight: 600; color: #ece8e1; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-explore > span { font-weight: 300; transition: transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-nav-explore:hover > span:first-child { transform: translateX(-4px); } .ds-nav-explore:hover > span:last-child { transform: translateX(4px); }

narrative.overview:
NOIR is a dark studio where a single object is carried through calibrated test positions, and every scene reads like one line of a chronometer certification bulletin. The interface recedes to a graphite ground, bone ink and hairlines; the real 3D watch is the only thing allowed to be loud, and even it speaks through one orange seconds hand. Density is deliberately low: one expanded-caps statement, one sentence, one measured reading per scene.

Three borrowed instruments shape the world. A darkroom zone ramp supplies the only tonal scale. An oscilloscope graticule supplies the hairline rules and leader lines that lock onto parts of the watch with a measured value. A multiplane camera supplies depth: display type sits on planes behind and in front of the WebGL watch, so the object crosses the words.
keyCharacteristics: One 11-step neutral ramp (z0 to z10) carries every surface, ink and rule.
One chromatic signal, reserved for the seconds hand and live measurement marks.
Archivo expanded capitals for statements; Geist Mono only for things that were measured.
Hairlines (1px) instead of fills, boxes or shadows.
Type on depth planes behind and in front of the 3D object.
Scroll-scrubbed scenes; UI motion is transform and opacity only.

rules.name: The Zone Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every surface, ink and rule resolves to a zone step or a transparent mix of one. No new neutrals, no tinted greys, no gradients between hues.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange marks time passing or a value being read. If an element is neither the seconds hand nor a live measurement (or the focus ring), it is not orange.

rules.name: The Role Flip Rule
rules.body: The light scene (Story) sets `data-theme='light'`, which flips the semantic roles (ground to z10, ink to z0, ink-2 to z4, ink-3 to z5); the ramp itself never changes. Light is one scene, not a second theme.

rules.name: The Measured Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono prints only what an instrument could read: millimetres, bar, Hz, vph, positions, rates, years. A word that is not a value is a label, set in Archivo.

rules.name: The Measured Width Rule
rules.body: Display sizes are chosen from the longest word's em width against the space it must clear, and the measurement is recorded next to the value. Never size a statement by eye.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Step Rule
rules.body: A multi-line statement may step its second line inward (0.9em, 0.6em on phones) and drop it to z6 (z5 on bone). One step per statement.

rules.name: The Multiplane Rule
rules.body: Display type lives on a plane behind or in front of the object, never in a box beside it. On phones a statement may move to the front plane so it crosses the strap instead.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. The only inset shadow in the system is the 1px bone ring that outlines a material swatch.

dos: Do take every neutral from the z0..z10 ramp or a transparent oklab mix of it.
Do keep Signal Orange to the seconds hand and live measurement marks (reticle, chip edge, selected index notch, pressed pin, measured unit), plus the focus ring.
Do set statements in Archivo width 125 capitals, sized from the measured em width of the longest word, with the measurement noted beside the value.
Do use Geist Mono only for measured values, positions and years; use the Archivo width-118 label for every other UI word.
Do put display type on a depth plane relative to the watch rather than beside it in a container.
Do make every CTA the label-plus-extending-hairline form, animated by transform only.
Do keep touch targets at 44px (24px for rail ticks) and honour reduced motion by snapping poses.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or use signal for emphasis, headings, backgrounds or decoration.
Don't add drop shadows or raised cards; separate with hairlines and translucent graphite.
Don't set non-measured words in mono, or measured values in the label face.
Don't use filled button slabs or pill-shaped CTAs; pills belong to selection chips and explore controls only.
Don't make light a site-wide theme; the Story scene is the one role flip.
Don't animate width, height or layout properties for UI state.
